committee: * Presentation for Certificate No. 389-38 (COR) -Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane
title: Håfa Adai, Please join me in presenting Legislative Certificate No. 389-38 (COR), recognizing the outgoing 2025-2026 Board Members of the International Women’s Club of Guam during the Meeting and Installation of the 2026-2027 Board. The presentation is scheduled for Thursday, May 21, 2026, at 6:00 p.m. at the Hyatt Regency Guam, Tumon. For more information about the presentation, contact the Office of Legislative Secretary, Senator Sabrina Salas Matanane, at 671-989-2572 or via email at office.senatorbri@ guamlegislature.gov . 5.18.26 3:59PM (FN)
